create_trainer_instance: create a Trainer instance with modules, environment, and params to initialize training with optimizers and AMP support
run_enc_dec_step: run an encoder-decoder training step for a task by fetching a batch, computing loss, and optimizing
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with module state dicts and optimizer state to a specified path
reload_checkpoint: reload a model checkpoint from disk to resume training at a previous epoch and iteration
optimize_loss: optimize a loss tensor using regular or AMP optimization with gradient clipping and optimizer steps
